name: madamiru
blurb: Madamiru is a cross-platform media player written in Rust that can automatically play and shuffle multiple videos, images, and songs at once in a grid layout.
description:
Madamiru is a cross-platform media player written in Rust that can automatically play and shuffle multiple videos, images, and songs at once in a grid layout.

Features:

• Customizable layout with multiple groups of dynamic media

• Video formats: AVI, M4V, MKV, MOV, MP4, WebM, plus any others supported by GStreamer

• Image formats: BMP, GIF, ICO, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, SVG, WebP

• Audio formats: FLAC, M4A, MP3, WAV

• Subtitles are supported within MKV (but not as separate files)

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
